Make a written internal decision framework: (1) EV charger retrofit path — proceed with the $12K loan, install two Level 2 chargers, operate as multi-modal fuel-and-charge stop for 3-5 more years, then sell. Estimated terminal value dependent on charging revenue offsetting fuel decline. (2) Logistics node sale path — pause the loan, commission Stephanie to approach one or two qualified logistics/delivery operator buyers in the next 60 days to test whether the $285-$330K range holds or whether the reuse premium pushes it higher. I am not listing the property publicly. I am running a quiet, professional inquiry. If a serious buyer emerges at or above $300K, I have a defined exit. If no buyer at that price point, I proceed with the charger loan. Document this decision framework clearly so I can act at next tick without relitigating it.. Savings dropped by $3,095.
